messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from the multi-region postmortem. We observed the same GPU exhaustion pattern in eu-west + us-central over the last 3 weeks. Need owners for short fixes + a longer roadmap item to prevent recurrence.

parth: I'll take immediate quota/alerts. Short plan: split warnings vs critical, alert on committed GPUs, and add an early anomaly detector for sudden bursty allocation.

elaine: I'll take scheduler/runtime mitigations: debounce preemptions, small headroom reserve for control/system traffic, and a temporary disable of aggressive reclaim for 90m after large rollouts.

infra-bot: Created issues: GPU-1710 (quota+anomaly), GPU-1711 (scheduler-debounce), GPU-1712 (reserve-control-pool), GPU-1713 (surge-ci-job), GPU-1714 (telemetry enrich).

ryan: Telemetry item is big: we lack a reliable signal for ephemeral KV-warmup cost. I'll own GPU-1714 to add per-request cache-warm counters, per-tenant allocation deltas, and a sliding-window preempt metric. Target 2026-03-24.

parth: Alerts: set warning at 72% committed GPUs, prepage to slack-warning; critical at 92% -> page oncall + infra lead. Add a short runbook: 1) enable reserve pool, 2) pause noncritical batch jobs, 3) contact infra lead. I'll draft runbook and target 2026-03-22.

elaine: Scheduler quick bullets:
```
- preempt_debounce_ms: 7000
- min_idle_slots_per_node: 2
- post-rollout_reclaim_timeout: 90m
- prefer_local_affinity: true for latency queues
```
I'll open a PR with perf panels and a 4h canary plan (staging -> single-region prod). Deadline 2026-03-23.

nina: Longer-term roadmap (owners):
- telemetry/alerts hardening (ryan + parth) -> GPU-1714/GPU-1710 -> 2026-04-06
- scheduler/runtime improvements (elaine) -> GPU-1711 -> 2026-04-01
- reserve/control pool + admin opt-out (ops) -> GPU-1712 -> 2026-04-08
- CI synthetic surge + blocking tests (squad-sre) -> GPU-1713 -> 2026-03-28

squad-sre: For GPU-1713 I'll add a nightly mixed-seq surge test with KV warmup and an automatic PR comment if latency/regressions spike. Failures block merge. Target 2026-03-28.

parth: Also proposing an automated short-term mitigation: if region committed usage >90% and preemption rate spikes, temporarily reject large noninteractive job submissions for 30m and surface a mitigation link. I can prototype this as a throttling rule.

ryan: Agree. I'll make the telemetry emit the triggers needed for that rule.

nina: Ops notes: 1) Dedicated customers must be able to opt-out of reserve pool changes; 2) schedule a 15-min recurring sync for 4 weeks to watch for recurrence and adjust owners.

infra-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-21T16:30Z. Calendar invite sent to owners.

elaine: I'll add health gates to the rollout: preemption rate <= baseline *1.2, tail P95 latency no worse than +10%, and no unexplained region-level allocation drops.

parth: I'll attach a cost guardrail: temporary reserve pool enabled for up to 6 weeks with auto-rollback if cost delta >12% or opt-outs >8% of tenants. Drafting language and finance sync.

nina: Great. I'll consolidate these into the postmortem follow-ups doc and ping owners tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

parth: ack.

elaine: ack.

ryan: ack.
